# SparkSplit Decision Card Component
**Generated by Resonance Engine v1.0**

## Component Specification

### Emotional Context
- **Primary Tone**: Confident, strategic
- **Trust Level**: 4.6 (High confidence in decision-making)
- **Urgency Level**: Medium (Decision required, but not rushed)
- **Personalization Depth**: Contextual (User name, plan tier, decision history)

### Memberstack Bindings
- `user.firstName` → Display name with fallback "Strategist"
- `plan.tier` → Decision complexity level (Basic/Pro/Enterprise)
- `user.decisionHistory` → Previous SparkSplit usage count
- `user.preferredTone` → Tone override for microcopy

### Fallback States
1. **Loading**: "Analyzing your options — brilliant insights incoming..."
2. **Error**: "A quick glitch in the matrix — let's recalibrate and try again."
3. **Empty Data**: "Ready to spark your first decision? Let's explore together."
4. **Session Timeout**: "We're still with you — let's reconnect your strategic flow."

### Visual Validation
- Capture states: loading, error, empty, success
- Emotional states: confident, reassuring, empowering
- Memberstack states: guest, basic, pro, enterprise

## Generated Implementation

### Main Component (`SparkSplitDecisionCard.tsx`)

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { useMemberstackResonance } from '../adapters/memberstack-resonance';
import { TrustFallbackProvider } from '../fallbacks/trust-fallback-provider';
import { EmotionalPayload } from '../utils/emotion-payload-builder';
import { SparkIcon, LightningIcon, CheckCircleIcon } from '@heroicons/react/24/outline';

interface SparkSplitDecisionCardProps {
  decision: {
    title: string;
    options: DecisionOption[];
    context?: string;
  };
  onDecisionMade: (optionId: string) => void;
  emotionalOverride?: Partial<EmotionalPayload>;
  className?: string;
}

interface DecisionOption {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  confidence: number; // 0-1
  impact: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
  timeframe: string;
}

export const SparkSplitDecisionCard: React.FC<SparkSplitDecisionCardProps> = ({
  decision,
  onDecisionMade,
  emotionalOverride,
  className = ''
}) => {
  const { userData, planData, emotionalState } = useMemberstackResonance();
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = React.useState(false);

  // Personalization logic
  const displayName = userData?.firstName || "Strategist";
  const planTier = planData?.tier || "Explorer";
  const decisionCount = userData?.decisionHistory?.length || 0;
  
  // Emotional microcopy based on plan tier and history
  const getEncouragementText = () => {
    if (decisionCount === 0) {
      return `${displayName}, your first strategic decision awaits — let's make it brilliant.`;
    }
    if (planTier === 'Enterprise') {
      return `${displayName}, your ${decisionCount + 1}th strategic insight is taking shape.`;
    }
    return `${displayName}, building on ${decisionCount} smart decisions — what's next?`;
  };

  const handleOptionSelect = async (optionId: string) => {
    setSelectedOption(optionId);
    setIsProcessing(true);
    
    try {
      await onDecisionMade(optionId);
      // Success state handled by parent
    } catch (error) {
      // Error fallback will be triggered by TrustFallbackProvider
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const fallbackConfig = {
    loading: {
      trigger: 'slow',
      severity: 'low',
      microcopy: "Analyzing your options — brilliant insights incoming...",
      emotionalScore: 4.5
    },
    error: {
      trigger: 'error',
      severity: 'medium', 
      microcopy: "A quick glitch in the matrix — let's recalibrate and try again.",
      emotionalScore: 4.3,
      recoveryAction: () => setIsProcessing(false)
    },
    empty: {
      trigger: 'empty',
      severity: 'low',
      microcopy: "Ready to spark your first decision? Let's explore together.",
      emotionalScore: 4.6
    }
  };

  return (
    <TrustFallbackProvider fallbacks={fallbackConfig}>
      <div className={`spark-split-card bg-white rounded-xl shadow-lg border border-gray-100 p-6 ${className}`}>
        {/* Header with emotional context */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
          <div className="p-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00CFFF] to-[#00F0FF] rounded-lg">
            <SparkIcon className="w-6 h-6 text-white" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900">{decision.title}</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-[#00B2E3]">{getEncouragementText()}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Context if provided */}
        {decision.context && (
          <div className="mb-6 p-4 bg-[#E6F6FF] rounded-lg border-l-4 border-[#00CFFF]">
            <p className="text-gray-700">{decision.context}</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Decision options */}
        <div className="space-y-3 mb-6">
          {decision.options.map((option) => (
            <div
              key={option.id}
              className={`
                decision-option p-4 rounded-lg border-2 cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200
                ${selectedOption === option.id 
                  ? 'border-[#00CFFF] bg-[#E6F6FF] shadow-md' 
                  : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-[#00B2E3] hover:bg-gray-50'
                }
              `}
              onClick={() => setSelectedOption(option.id)}
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <h4 className="font-medium text-gray-900 mb-1">{option.title}</h4>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-2">{option.description}</p>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs">
                    <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-full ${
                      option.impact === 'high' ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700' :
                      option.impact === 'medium' ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700' :
                      'bg-green-100 text-green-700'
                    }`}>
                      {option.impact} impact
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-gray-500">{option.timeframe}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">Confidence</div>
                    <div className="font-medium text-[#00CFFF]">
                      {Math.round(option.confidence * 100)}%
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {selectedOption === option.id && (
                    <CheckCircleIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-[#00CFFF]" />
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Action button */}
        <button
          onClick={() => selectedOption && handleOptionSelect(selectedOption)}
          disabled={!selectedOption || isProcessing}
          className={`
            w-full py-3 px-6 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all duration-200
            ${selectedOption && !isProcessing
              ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00CFFF] to-[#00F0FF] text-white hover:shadow-lg hover:scale-[1.02]'
              : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed'
            }
          `}
        >
          {isProcessing ? (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
              <LightningIcon className="w-4 h-4 animate-pulse" />
              <span>Sparking your decision...</span>
            </div>
          ) : selectedOption ? (
            `Commit to this path`
          ) : (
            'Select an option to continue'
          )}
        </button>

        {/* Trust indicator for plan tier */}
        <div className="mt-4 text-center">
          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">
            {planTier} Decision Engine • Trust Score: {emotionalState?.trustScore?.toFixed(1) || '4.6'}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </TrustFallbackProvider>
  );
};
```

### Hook Implementation (`useSparkSplitData.tsx`)

```typescript
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useMemberstackResonance } from '../adapters/memberstack-resonance';
import { createEmotionalPayload } from '../utils/emotion-payload-builder';

export const useSparkSplitData = (decisionId: string) => {
  const { userData, planData } = useMemberstackResonance();
  const [decisionHistory, setDecisionHistory] = useState([]);
  const [emotionalContext, setEmotionalContext] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const initializeEmotionalContext = async () => {
      const payload = await createEmotionalPayload({
        tone: 'confident',
        trustScore: 4.6,
        payload: `Decision analysis for ${userData?.firstName || 'user'}`,
        metadata: {
          decisionId,
          planTier: planData?.tier,
          previousDecisions: decisionHistory.length
        }
      });
      setEmotionalContext(payload);
    };

    initializeEmotionalContext();
  }, [decisionId, userData, planData]);

  return {
    decisionHistory,
    emotionalContext,
    planTier: planData?.tier || 'Explorer',
    displayName: userData?.firstName || 'Strategist'
  };
};
```

### Test Suite (`SparkSplitDecisionCard.test.tsx`)

```typescript
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { SparkSplitDecisionCard } from './SparkSplitDecisionCard';
import { EmotionalValidator } from '../../validators/emotional-validator';

describe('SparkSplitDecisionCard', () => {
  const mockDecision = {
    title: 'Choose Your Marketing Strategy',
    options: [
      {
        id: 'option-1',
        title: 'Content Marketing Focus',
        description: 'Build authority through valuable content',
        confidence: 0.85,
        impact: 'medium',
        timeframe: '3-6 months'
      },
      {
        id: 'option-2', 
        title: 'Paid Advertising Blitz',
        description: 'Rapid customer acquisition through ads',
        confidence: 0.72,
        impact: 'high',
        timeframe: '1-2 months'
      }
    ]
  };

  test('renders with emotional resonance', async () => {
    const onDecisionMade = jest.fn();
    render(
      <SparkSplitDecisionCard 
        decision={mockDecision}
        onDecisionMade={onDecisionMade}
      />
    );

    // Check emotional microcopy
    expect(screen.getByText(/your first strategic decision awaits/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    
    // Validate emotional score
    const validator = new EmotionalValidator();
    const emotionalScore = await validator.validateComponent(screen.getByRole('main'));
    expect(emotionalScore).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4.2);
  });

  test('handles Memberstack data gracefully', () => {
    // Test with mock Memberstack data
    const mockUserData = { firstName: 'Sarah', planTier: 'Pro' };
    
    render(
      <SparkSplitDecisionCard 
        decision={mockDecision}
        onDecisionMade={jest.fn()}
      />
    );

    // Should show personalized greeting
    expect(screen.getByText(/Sarah, building on/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  test('displays fallback states with emotional intelligence', async () => {
    const onDecisionMade = jest.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error('Network error'));
    
    render(
      <SparkSplitDecisionCard 
        decision={mockDecision}
        onDecisionMade={onDecisionMade}
      />
    );

    // Select option and trigger error
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Content Marketing Focus'));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Commit to this path'));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/quick glitch in the matrix/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
});
```
